question: True or false: with the Soviet bloc absent, the United States won fewer than a fifth of the gold medals at Los Angeles 1984?
answer: False. It won 83 golds from about 220 events, more than a third, and 174 medals in all. The two countries that had topped the table in 1976, the Soviet Union and East Germany, stayed home, so many American wins came against a field missing its strongest rivals.
move: Before celebrating a win, ask who was not in the race.
ask: Which of my wins came partly because the strongest rivals simply did not show up?
trap: Guessing a normal share, forgetting how many top rivals stayed home.
source: LA84, Official Report of the 1984 Games
reference: Los Angeles Olympic Organizing Committee, Official Report of the Games of the XXIIIrd Olympiad Los Angeles, 1984, LA84 Foundation, 1985
